title: Taylor Swift: 1989 review – leagues ahead of the teen-pop competition | Taylor Swift | The Guardian
quote: It’s more that Swift’s music attracts the kind of serious critical attention afforded almost none of her peers.

title: Daft Punk, 'Random Access Memories'
quote: Then there’s the full package – a 70-minute­-plus, over-the-top concept LP of prog-rocking, reverse-engineered dance music orbiting somewhere between Pink Floyd‘s Dark Side of the Moon and Earth, Wind and Fire‘s That’s the Way of the World.

title: Daft Punk: Random Access Memories – review | Daft Punk | The Guardian
quote: If you want proof that Random Access Memories is, by some distance, the most eagerly anticipated album of recent years, then here it is.

title: Back to Black
quote: "Rehab," the must-hear song that opens the second album from British soul singer Amy Winehouse, is a Motown-style winner with a banging beat and a lovesick bad girl testifying like Etta James about how she won't clean up her act.

title: Amy Winehouse
quote: There’s an acoustic take on Phil Spector’s ‘To Know Him Is To Love Him’ that breathes booze over the most straight-laced song ever, an adequate reading of ska standard ‘Monkey Man’ and a good demo of ‘Some Unholy War’.

title: Norah Jones: Come Away with Me Tracks & Reviews | AllMusic
quote: There's a touch of Rickie Lee Jones in Jones' voice, a touch of Bonnie Raitt in the arrangements; her youth and her piano skills could lead one to call her an Alicia Keys for grown-ups.
